definition: A candidate placed from further down the composer's ranked list because too few of the set asked for could be drawn. One not refused joins the set; one it does not take is named with its reason and not offered, unless the brief named it.
more: It is ranked by the same key as the rest, so a house that may be drawn but carries a fatal finding never leads one without. The composer places only a few more, and only within the set's time: it stops at whichever of the two bounds comes first, and names each diagram it did not reach with the bound that stopped it. A diagram the brief named is returned anyway, as the named diagram, and is not listed as passed over.
basis: Our wording of the composer's pool-fill. build/compose.py, compose: "fewer of the set are drawable than were asked for, the loop places down the pool"; build/compose.py, compose: "placed and still refused is named with its reason, and each the budget did not reach is named." Its two bounds: "the set's time ran out (fewer than five seconds left) before the next placement" and "diagrams were placed from the pool, with time left". A named diagram's "passed-over entry is MARKED, not dropped, so the pool-fill's count can say it was" returned anyway as the named diagram.
